question: What is the total item revenue from delivered orders that were paid at least partly by boleto?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'boleto')
assumptions_used: ASSUMPTION A1: sales / delivery = delivered orders only; ASSUMPTION A2: revenue = SUM(order_items.price), freight not included
item_notes: Drafted by Claude on 2026-11-09 after prompts/v5.txt was written; not tuned on. Trap: joining order_payments directly repeats items for orders with several payment rows.

question: How many delivered orders have more than one item and also more than one payment record?
gold_sql: WITH i AS (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), p AS (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
assumptions_used: ASSUMPTION A1: sales / delivery = delivered orders only
item_notes: Drafted by Claude on 2026-11-09 after prompts/v5.txt was written; not tuned on. Trap: counting rows after joining items and payments counts item x payment pairs, not orders.
